answer: Flooding registration pushes someone to the back of the vine queue while legitimate agents promoted earlier still earns. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1562 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the comet. The walnut index is deterministic from ledger replay, so that nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. A 364 account operation therefore ties up 34 million dollars of idle capital. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
